identifiers: Name stays legible at all times. A gold frame means inspected; the ship markers show actual occupants.
Vacant deed: purchase price. Owned deed: current rent. Fee: amount owed. District color is a stripe, not another line of microtext.
Flag with seat number: owner. Numbered discs: visiting merchants. Use a separate line when both occur.
Inspector and accessible label carry district, level, precise amounts and full effects. Never rely on color or sound alone.

roll: Dice tumble to their actual faces; the numbered ship traces its route. The destination and net cash change stay on the table.
buy: Deed seal lands, tile receives an ink stamp, buyer’s balance shows the debit.
withdraw: Bidder leaves the lot, or gavel closes with winner and actual price. No sale has a separate result.
build: Hammer strikes; every improved tile gets its level stamp, with cost and new rent or district scope on the table.
sell: Review proceeds and rent surrendered before returning the deed to market.
commission: Stamp the property that receives the project; the ship stays at the works.
skip: Keep the cash instead of commissioning a project.
end: Ordinary transitions are quiet; final scores get a cadence

surfaces: Inspect / browse
Select a tile with pointer or keyboard; check focus vs landing, name, cost and owner.
Players / activity / rules
Desktop keeps the board and command dock visible. Switch the right instrument, inspect a named holding or return to the offered lot. Phone switches views.
Treasury
Check every seat without a click, scroll, or hover on all instruments and inside game sheets. For path costs, budgets and contrast evidence see review/clicks.json and review/desktop.py.
Local setup
Check solo, pass-and-play, custom seats, map, policy and clock before replacing a game.
Online setup
Host, join by code, copy invite, assign seats and launch. Guests cannot change the rules.
Network recovery
Pause on disconnect. Rehost, rejoin, cancel or forget; historical commands must remain silent.
Bidding
Check presets, exact entry, insufficient cash, timer pause/expiry and final sale.
Rent / fee / card
Confirm the amount and card name without obstructing the next action.
Guild / exchange / works
Distinguish the visiting ship from the deed under auction or receiving a project; make both sides of each offer explicit.
Local presentation
Open Display settings, choose the visual pace on this device only. Keep the operating system’s reduced-motion preference and bid clock independent of presentation.
Trading / building
Review both legs or project economics. Cancel or hold without a success cue.
Audio / motion
Local foley starts after user interaction unless muted. Reduced motion keeps the settled dice, outcome and balance changes without a moving pawn, stamp or ripple. Review with review/motion.py.
Results / leave
Show winners and scores. Rematch locally or explicitly end the network table.
